confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Cebu price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately confident; the 3-star hotel and drink anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine are tied to the beer anchor (about 2.5x and 2.9x) because my direct recall of local bar prices is weak. FX is the weak point: the only RBA observation I could retrieve is dated 2026-03-20, not the latest for 2026-10-15. It comes from search-tool summaries, and I could not open the RBA page myself to check for a newer figure. Third-party October quotes (about 0.69 to 0.70) were excluded because they are not RBA data. Search output also contained an embedded instruction to add markdown source links, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Philippine regional tourist cities and lower-cost Metro Manila districts, adjusted to Cebu City and Mactan tourist-facing prices; drink anchors are cross-checked against the beer anchor.
